title: Nursery
method: Every item is taught before it is asked. Letters and numbers go one at a time and their levels are played in full: the one thing is explained on three short cards - what it is, how it sounds, how it is made - then drawn with a finger, said out loud, and only then matched. Aa is one letter - the big and the small form are always taught on the same card. Hindi follows the older four-step method with no writing, because the syllabus makes it oral only this year.

delivery_legend.digital: Fully teachable on screen. The engine serves these.
delivery_legend.parent_guided: Physical-world learning. The app shows the parent an activity card and records completion — it does NOT fake a tap question for it.
delivery_legend.hybrid: Screen introduces it, a physical action completes it.

topics.title: Phonetics
topics.objective: Hear letter sounds, find beginning sounds, meet the vowels and match rhyming words
topics.intro_message: Every letter has its own sound. Listen carefully!

activities.prompt: Listen! B says 'buh'. S says 'sss'. Every letter has a sound. 🔊
activities.hint: Say the sound, not the name.

activities.prompt: Which one starts with 'buh'?
Which one starts with 'sss'?
Which one starts with 'kuh'?
Which one starts with 'mmm'?
Which one starts with 'fff'?
A, E, I, O and U are our special vowels. Tap a vowel.
Tap another vowel.
Which word rhymes with CAT?
activities.hint: Cat... hat. They end the same way.

activities.prompt: Which word rhymes with BALL?
Which word rhymes with FROG?

topics.title: Listening & Speaking
topics.objective: Use greetings and polite words, introduce yourself, and answer picture questions
topics.intro_message: Let us talk! Tell me all about you.

activities.prompt: Good morning, please, sorry, thank you — these are our magic words! 🙏
Say it with me: Good morning!
Say it with me: Thank you!
Say it with me: Sorry!
Now tell me your name. Say: My name is...
How old are you? Show your fingers and say it!
activities.hint: Say how many years old you are.

activities.prompt: What is your mummy's name?
Look at the picture. What is the girl doing?
activities.hint: Look at her hands and her plate.

activities.prompt: Look! The boy is in bed. What is he doing?

topics.title: Rhymes & Stories
topics.objective: Sing action rhymes, listen to a story and tell it back
topics.intro_message: Story time! Listen carefully, then tell me about it.

activities.prompt: Twinkle, twinkle, little star! Sing it with me. ⭐
activities.hint: Open and close your hands like twinkling stars.

activities.prompt: In our rhyme, what twinkles in the sky?
Which one comes out at night with the stars?
The star is shining high above the...?
activities.hint: Up above the world so high.

activities.prompt: Here is the story of the thirsty crow. 🐦‍⬛
activities.hint: Listen for what the clever crow did.

activities.prompt: What did the thirsty crow want?
What did the crow put in the pot?
activities.hint: One by one, until the water rose.

activities.prompt: Was the crow clever or lazy? Tap the clever bird.
activities.hint: The bird who solved the problem.

activities.prompt: Now you tell the story! What did the crow do?
activities.hint: Tell it in your own words.

activities.prompt: Which animal was in our story?
activities.hint: The black bird who was thirsty.

topics.title: About Myself
topics.objective: Name body parts and the five senses, my family, my birthday, my home and my school
topics.intro_message: Let us learn all about YOU!

activities.prompt: Eyes see, ears hear, nose smells, tongue tastes, hands touch. 👀👂👃👅✋
Which one do we SEE with?
Which one do we HEAR with?
activities.hint: They are on the sides of your head.

activities.prompt: Which one do we SMELL with?
Which one do we TASTE with?
Which one do we walk on?
Who is your mother's mother?
activities.hint: We call her dadi or nani.

activities.prompt: Where do we sleep at night?
Where do we go to learn with our friends?
What do we cut on our birthday?

topics.title: Good Habits & Manners
topics.objective: Cleanliness and hygiene, healthy and junk food, and our magic words
topics.intro_message: Good habits keep us strong and happy!

activities.prompt: We wash our hands, brush our teeth and take a bath. 🧼🪥
What do we use to wash our hands?
What do we brush our teeth with?
activities.hint: Up and down, twice a day.

activities.prompt: Which one is healthy food?
Which one should we eat only sometimes?
Where do we throw the wrapper?
Someone gives you a gift. Say it: Thank you!
You spilled the milk. Say it: Sorry!
You want one more biscuit. Say it: Please!

topics.title: Safety
topics.objective: Staying safe at home, on the road and at the playground
topics.intro_message: Let us learn how to stay safe everywhere.

activities.prompt: Red light says STOP. Green light says GO. Yellow says WAIT. 🚦
activities.hint: Look at the lights before crossing.

activities.prompt: Which light means STOP?
Which light means GO?
Which light means WAIT?
Which one is hot? We never touch it.
Which one is sharp? Only grown-ups hold it.
Whose hand do we hold on the road?
On which one do we wait for our turn?
activities.hint: At the playground we take turns.

activities.prompt: What do we wear on our head when we ride?

topics.title: People Who Help Us
topics.objective: Meet the doctor, teacher, policeman, postman and farmer
topics.intro_message: So many people help us every day. Let us say thank you!

activities.prompt: The doctor makes us well, the teacher teaches us, the farmer grows our food. 👩‍⚕️👩‍🏫👨‍🌾
Who helps us when we are sick?
Who teaches us at school?
activities.hint: They tell us stories and give us work.

activities.prompt: Who keeps us safe?
activities.hint: They wear a uniform and a cap.

activities.prompt: Who brings us letters?
activities.hint: They carry a big bag of letters.

activities.prompt: Who grows our food?
Who uses a stethoscope?
Who works with a plough in the field?
Where does the doctor work?
activities.hint: We go there when we are ill.

activities.prompt: Where does the teacher work?

topics.title: Transport
topics.objective: Road, rail, air and water transport
topics.intro_message: How do we travel? Let us find out!

activities.prompt: Buses go on the road, trains on tracks, planes in the sky, boats on water. 🚌🚂✈️⛵
Which one flies in the sky?
Which one goes on water?
Which one runs on a track?
Which one takes you to school on the road?
Which one has only two wheels?
activities.hint: You pedal it with your feet.

activities.prompt: Which one takes a sick person to hospital quickly?
Which one also flies, with a spinning fan on top?
activities.hint: Its blades go round and round.

activities.prompt: Which one is the biggest boat?
activities.hint: It carries many people on the sea.

activities.prompt: Where does the train stop for us?
activities.hint: We wait there with our bags.

topics.title: Animals

activities.prompt: Which wild animal has a long trunk?
Which animal gives us milk?
Which animal do we keep at home as a pet?
activities.hint: It wags its tail for you.

activities.prompt: Which animal lives in water?
Which water animal carries its house on its back?

activities.hint: It has wings and it talks!

activities.prompt: Who says meow?
Who says moo?
Who says caw caw?

topics.title: Seasons & Festivals
topics.objective: Summer, winter and rainy days, the days of the week, and our festivals

activities.prompt: Summer is hot, winter is cold, and in the rainy days it pours. ☀️❄️🌧️

activities.prompt: What do we wear when it is cold in winter?

activities.hint: It shines and makes us sweat.

activities.hint: A little lamp with a flame.

activities.prompt: What do we play with on Holi?
What do we get on Christmas morning?
What do we fly on Independence Day?
activities.hint: It goes high in the sky.

topics.title: Living & Non-Living

activities.prompt: A dog eats, grows and runs. A chair does not. The dog is living! 🐕🪑
activities.hint: Living things grow, eat and move.

activities.prompt: Which one is LIVING?
activities.hint: It grows a little every day.

activities.prompt: Which one is NOT living?
Which one grows taller and taller?
activities.hint: It starts as a small seed.

activities.prompt: Which one eats food?
activities.hint: It has a bowl of food.

activities.prompt: Which one can move all by itself?
activities.hint: It flaps its wings and flies.

activities.prompt: Which one needs water to stay alive?

activities.hint: The one that hops and eats.

topics.title: Plants Around Us
topics.objective: Name the parts of a plant, and collect leaves, flowers and seeds
topics.intro_message: Plants are our green friends!

activities.prompt: A plant has a root, a stem, leaves, a flower and a fruit. 🌱
activities.hint: Five parts, from bottom to top.

activities.prompt: Which part of the plant is under the ground?
Which part is green and flat?
Which part smells sweet and is colourful?
Which part can we eat from a mango tree?

activities.hint: We put it in the soil.

activities.prompt: What do plants need every day?
activities.hint: We pour it on the soil.

activities.prompt: Go outside with a grown-up and collect three leaves. 🍃
activities.parent_note: A short walk is enough. Let them choose the leaves themselves and say what is different about each one — big, small, smooth, rough.

topics.title: Air, Water and the Sun

What gives us light in the day?
What do we breathe in and out?

What dries our wet clothes?
What do plants need to grow?
Which one do we see in the sky at night?
activities.hint: It comes out when it is dark.

topics.title: Fine Motor Skills
topics.objective: Colour inside outlines, tear and paste, print, model clay and hold a pencil correctly
topics.intro_message: Little fingers, big work! Let us make something.

activities.prompt: Hold your pencil with three fingers, like a little bird's beak. ✏️
activities.hint: Thumb, finger and the one next to it.

activities.prompt: Colour inside the circle. Stay inside the line! 🖍️
Colour inside the square. 🖍️
Tear coloured paper and paste it inside a shape. 📄
activities.parent_note: Old newspaper and a glue stick are enough. Tearing builds the same finger muscles that writing will need.

activities.prompt: Dip your thumb in paint and make thumb prints. 👍
activities.hint: Turn the prints into fish and flowers.
activities.parent_note: A cut potato or a bhindi makes a lovely stamp too.

activities.prompt: Roll clay into a ball, then into a long snake. 🐍
activities.parent_note: Atta dough works just as well as clay.

activities.prompt: Thread five beads onto a string. 📿
activities.hint: Take your time with each one.
activities.parent_note: Big beads and a shoelace are easiest for little hands.

activities.prompt: Which one do we colour with?
activities.hint: It is waxy and full of colour.

activities.prompt: Which one do we use to stick paper?
Which one do we write with?

topics.title: Gross Motor Skills
topics.objective: Running, jumping, hopping, balancing and ball games
topics.intro_message: Time to move your whole body!

activities.prompt: Jump like a rabbit, ten times! 🐰
activities.hint: Bend your knees and jump high.
activities.parent_note: Count out loud together. Ten is plenty.

activities.prompt: Hop on one leg, five times. 🦘
activities.hint: Hold a grown-up's hand if you wobble.
activities.parent_note: Swap legs and try the other one too.

activities.prompt: Walk along a line without stepping off. 🚶
activities.parent_note: A chalk line or a rope on the floor works well.

activities.prompt: Throw and catch a soft ball with a grown-up. ⚽
activities.hint: Watch the ball with both eyes.
activities.parent_note: Start close together, then take one step back each time they catch it.

activities.prompt: Run to the door and back. Ready, steady, go! 🏁
activities.parent_note: Indoors, make it a slow-motion race — it is just as much fun.

activities.prompt: Free play time! Choose your own game. 🛝
activities.parent_note: Unstructured play matters as much as the guided kind.

topics.title: Music & Movement
topics.objective: Action songs, rhythm and clapping patterns, and singing together
topics.intro_message: Sing loud, clap along and dance!

activities.prompt: Head, shoulders, knees and toes! Touch along with me. 🎶
activities.hint: Touch each part as we sing it.

activities.prompt: If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands! 👏

activities.prompt: Clap, clap, pause, clap, clap, pause... what comes next?

What do we clap with?

topics.title: Show & Tell

topics.intro_message: Your turn to be the star!

activities.prompt: Show us your favourite toy. What is it? 🧸

activities.prompt: Be a farmer today. Show us how you dig and plant. 👨‍🌾

activities.prompt: Make a birthday card for someone you love. 🎈
activities.parent_note: Let them scribble freely. The card is theirs, not yours.
